card.statement: Let $A$ be the algebra of polynomial functions on an irreducible smooth affine variety $X$. Let $\DD$ be the Lie algebra of polynomial vector fields on $X$. As a $\DD$-module, $A$ has a unique proper submodule, which is 1-dimensional and consists of the constant functions.
card.label: Theorem 15

paper.title: Lie algebras of vector fields on smooth affine varieties
paper.abstract: We reprove the results of Jordan [18] and Siebert [31] and show that the Lie algebra of polynomial vector fields on an irreducible affine variety X is simple if and only if X is a smooth variety. Given proof is self-contained and does not depend on papers mentioned above. Besides, the structure of the module of polynomial functions on an irreducible smooth affine variety over the Lie algebra of vector fields is studied. Examples of Lie algebras of polynomial vector fields on an N-dimensional sphere, non-singular hyperelliptic curves and linear algebraic groups are considered.
